frontmatter.name: naming-law
frontmatter.description: NON-DISMISSABLE project law for naming everything in WebJin: Python variables, models, related_names, URL names and paths, template/block names, context keys, DOM ids, JS, CSS, static files, enums and the Persian/English glossary. Use whenever ANY code, template, migration, test, URL or skill is created, renamed, reviewed or audited, even for a one-line change, and before any other skill adds a name.

frontmatter.name: security-agent
frontmatter.description: Reviews and implements security for WebJin: CSRF, CSP and nonces, captcha, staff gating, input validation, XSS in templates and JS, URL scheme validation, rate limits, privacy of owner email, secrets, safe GET/POST. Use on every feature touching input, auth, AJAX, templates with user data, settings, third-party scripts (Yektanet), or before release.
